interpretation: Read emission order; IDs can repeat and are not numerically monotonic.
A missing end marker followed by a rejection/catch marker denotes a failed condition or thrown operation, not necessarily a stall.
The last observed stage localizes only this later instrumented derivative, not the original invocation.
Derivative timing, cache state and instrumentation differ from the original.
Stdin finish records writable completion only; it is not proof of payload consumption or EOF.
No derivative observation may substitute for the original identity proof.
